text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! Will you grant Maya the wish 
of a lifetime?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I want a shoulder massage! Maya's 
head hurts sooooo bad.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Trainer's love for Maya will blow 
all the pain away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Here, like this... Pain, pain, go away—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Urrghhh, whyyy... It hurts... way more 
than this morninggg...

Afterward, I cared for her by giving her 
medicine and other remedies, but Mayano 
Top Gun's headache just wouldn't go 
away...
